# search fixed-orientation 3x3 jigsaw using one window from each of the 9 connected components
ids=list(opts)
sols=[]
# de-duplicate identical arrays per comp, retain earliest coordinates
opts2={k:[] for k in ids}
for k,v in opts.items():
 seen=set()
 for r,c,w,acs in v:
  key=tuple(w.flatten())
  if key not in seen:
   seen.add(key); opts2[k].append((r,c,w,acs))

def search_board(pos, used, placed):
 if pos==9:
  sols.append(placed.copy()); return len(sols)>=100
 r,c=divmod(pos,3)
 for k in ids:
  if k in used: continue
  for win in opts2[k]:
   _,_,w,acs=win
   if c and not np.array_equal(placed[pos-1][2][:,-1],w[:,0]): continue
   if r and not np.array_equal(placed[pos-3][2][-1,:],w[0,:]): continue
   placed.append((k,*win))
   stop=search_board(pos+1,used|{k},placed)
   placed.pop()
   if stop: return True
 return False
